column2: Month ○, Day × — Clear
At last...
At last, he opened his eyes!!
I'm so happy...
So happy, so happy, so happy!
I don't think I'll be able to sleep at all tonight...!
But he's lost every $$記憶$$ we shared...
Please...
Please, remember soon!!
Month △, Day ○ — Rain
I can't believe what I said today...
I was so bold, I even surprised myself!!
With the two of us alone, warming ourselves by the fireplace...
Somehow, everything began to feel so romantic...
And in his eyes, there was only me...
Of course there was—but still, it made me so happy...!
I truly...
I wish days like this could go on forever...
Month ◇, Day ◎ — Cloudy
This year, I finally decided to be brave and give him chocolate...!!
But...
He's lost all $$記憶$$, so...
I don't think he remembers what giving chocolate means to us women...
I don't think he remembers, anyway...
But maybe that makes it a little easier...?
Because if he remembered, and if he were to...
Oh, stop it! What am I hoping for...!?
Month ○, Day ■ — Clear
Lately,
He seems so restless... Like he can't settle down...!
Maybe he, too, is really...
Starting to want to leave this house...?
Oh, stop it! What am I thinking...!?
Month □, Day × — Clear
Lately, he...
Has seemed so much better...
But as he gets better, the fear inside me keeps growing...!!
Someday, he may...
Say he wants to leave this house...
Oh... what a terrible woman I am...!
That I can't be wholeheartedly happy that he's getting better...
